organizations.title: Organisations
organizations.subtitle: Manage every organisation on this EmailBridge instance.
organizations.suspend_body: “{name}” will stop syncing mail, sending messages and delivering webhooks until it is reactivated.
organizations.delete_body: “{name}” and all of its data will be erased. This cannot be undone.
organizations.delete_active_blocked: Switch to another organisation before deleting the one you are using.
organizations.field_slug_hint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens (2–48 characters).
organizations.field_status_hint: Suspended organisations cannot sync, send or deliver webhooks.
organizations.field_owner_email_hint: Invite an owner by email after the organisation is created.
organizations.slug_taken: This slug is already in use.
organizations.quota_invalid: Enter a whole number of at least 1.
organizations.quota_help_accounts: Maximum mail accounts in this organisation. Empty or unlimited leaves only the instance-wide cap.
organizations.quota_help_sendsPerDay: Messages the organisation may submit in a rolling 24 hours.
organizations.quota_help_sendsPerAccountMinute: Messages each account may submit in a rolling minute.
organizations.quota_help_endpoints: Maximum webhook endpoints in this organisation.
organizations.empty_hint: Create an organisation for a customer or team.
organizations.invite_error: Organisation was created but the owner invite failed.
organizations.no_permission_body: Only the instance owner can manage organisations on this server.
